children: Ronin requires users of Ronin Waypoint, keyless wallets, or social login to migrate their assets before October 31, 2026, or lose access. The Waypoint migration offers two routes: an automated tool to move assets to Ronin Stash, or a manual transfer to a Ronin Wallet.

Affected users must consolidate all their assets in one of these destinations to retain access to their accounts. The requirement covers existing holdings accessed through these wallet and login options.
The migration is now entering its final stage: Grace Period.
The Grace Period runs until October 31, 2026, 11:00 ET / 15:00 UTC / 22:00 VN.
After that, Ronin Waypoint will be fully sunset, and the migration will be complete!

title: Ronin: Waypoint migration requires users to move assets - 31 Oct 2026
